items.title: 71542_Bill Coleman autobiographical manuscript
items.q: We played some of the place I had been with Kirk

ctx.x: The bus driver stopped a few miles outside of St. Louis to gas up and I wanted to take a look. So I went inside the station and asked one of the attendants if I could use the toilet. From inside of the station, one could see when cars were coming from either direction and this fellow told me that I could go in the toilet, but not stay very long. I wasn't supposed to be seen coming out of the toilet by a white customer.

We played a one-nighter in Little Rock, Arkansas, and then on to Chicago where Kirk had a month engagement at the Grand Terrace which was one of the biggest and best known clubs in the city. One night, Tiny Bradshaw came to the club with a.....

party and sat with his back to the band and didn't speak to anyone in the orchestra. He certainly knew me because we had worked together in Luis Russell's orchestra at the Roseland, and he must have known Andy Kirk. But Tiny had had success as a band leader who played mostly in the Southern States and success had gone to his head.
